evidence.heading: Fact sheet: how print/output systems model business-form templates/A. CCM / transactional output/OpenText Exstream

facts.body:
- Design Manager holds design objects: "templates, data files, variables, output, output queues" and production equipment (https://www.opentext.com/assets/documents/en-US/pdf/opentext-exstream-design-manager-v23-x2-4-revwcag-en.pdf)
- Overflow is page-level: "Pages can flow to a designated flow page, copy itself for flow, or ignore for flow"; tables repeat headers/footers across pages with automatic widow/orphan control; data mapped visually from delimited, JSON, XML, ODBC, COBOL copybooks, print files; for line data "Standard channel codes for both ANSI and machine carriage controls are used to break the line data file into pages"; a "3211 Line Data Output" module exists (attribution via search snippet of the Designer data sheet: https://www.opentext.com/en/media/data-sheet/opentext-communications-exstream-designer-ds-en.pdf)
- Designs "are stored as objects in the design database" (https://www.ecodocx.com/blog/migration-path-from-document-sciences-xpression-to-opentext-exstream/)
- Releases 23.2–25.2 add "advanced approval workflows" with multiple approvers and "shared templates across multiple pages" (https://opentext.com/en/media/checklist/opentext-communications-version-comparison-chart-checklist-en.pdf); Content Author "Visual Compare" diffs submitted vs approved version (https://www.duckcreek.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/Exstream-CE-Content-Author-20.4.pdf)

evidence.heading: Fact sheet: how print/output systems model business-form templates/A. CCM / transactional output/Quadient Inspire

facts.body:
- Inspire Designer jobs are "Workflow" (WFD) files built by connecting functional modules: data input, data processing, Layout, Imposition, Output; reseller lists outputs PDF, PS, AFP, PPML (https://pr.www.ipros.com/en/POLAR-METHOD/product/detail/2000808263)
- Ricoh's product page lists Inspire Print Output streams: "AFP, PostScript, PCL, Metacode, XML and PDF", on-demand or batch; non-print channels email, web, SMS, mobile, fax (https://www.ricoh-usa.com/en/products/pd/software/commercial-industrial-printing-software/composition/quadient-inspire/_/R-QUA-INSP-CS1)
- Inspire Content Manager = repository with version control; Inspire Approval = "document proofing and approval system"; Inspire Compare checks "document integrity from version to version" (same URL)
- Quadient markets "Governance and approval workflows" and "Centralized templates and content" (https://www.quadient.com/en/customer-communications/inspire-designer-icm)
- Flow-area/overflow mechanics: UNVERIFIED (no public doc found; only reviewer remarks that "INSPIRE provides several settings for handling overflow", https://www.g2.com/products/quadient-inspire/reviews)

evidence.heading: Fact sheet: how print/output systems model business-form templates/A. CCM / transactional output/Smart Communications (SmartCOMM)

facts.body:
- A template selector names "one template, one channel, and optionally one language, idiom, jurisdiction, or brand" (https://www.smartcommunications.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/INNOVATE-Training-Multi-Recipient-Communication-Through-Template-Selectors.pdf)
- Output file type follows channel: Print → .afp/.pcl/.pdf/.ps/.tiff/.xml (also .docx); Email/Web → .html; SMS/plain text → .txt (https://knowledgehub.smartcommunications.com/v13/docs/smartcomm-action)
- "automatic version control of template resources, enabling authors to branch and withdraw resource versions" (https://www.smartcommunications.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/12/SmartCOMM-CRM-Solutions-Datasheet.pdf); "Template Editions" let one template vary by channel/brand/jurisdiction/language (example: 1 template replacing 56) (https://smartcommunications.com/?p=36835)
- Data model templates are "XML files with placeholders"; a data-model version is selected when binding (https://knowledgehub.smartcommunications.com/v17/docs/template-data-model); Draft Editor previews a template and the draft "can be forwarded for approval" (https://knowledgehub.smartcommunications.com/v17/docs/draft-editor)

evidence.heading: Fact sheet: how print/output systems model business-form templates/B. Print-stream / page-description forms/IBM AFP (MO:DCA)

facts.body:
- PAGEDEF "contains the specifications for the logical page layout… positioning, rotation, suppression, and font of entire lines of data or specific fields within a line"; FORMDEF carries OVERLAY/SUBGROUP (copy groups, bins) (https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/SSLTBW_2.1.0/com.ibm.zos.v2r1.apsu000/toc.htm)
- Pagedef substructure is the PageFormat, which says "where and how often a specific field of data will be printed" (https://det.wi.gov/Documents/AFP_User_Guide.pdf)
- Overlays are declared in the FORMDEF and may also be invoked inline via IPO (Include Page Overlay); page segments (IOCA/GOCA/BCOCA: logos, signatures, barcodes) via IPS; a page segment "can be printed only in the ACROSS direction" (https://documents.bmc.com/supportu/INC/9.0.21/en-US/AFP_in_the_Control-D_Environment_Implementation_Guide/The_AFP_Architecture.htm)
- For traditional line data an overlay is positioned "relative to a print line"; PPFA CONSTANT prints a medium overlay alone (constant forms); max "eight medium overlays and one preprinted form overlay" per subgroup (https://www.ibm.com/support/knowledgecenter/SSLTBW_2.1.0/com.ibm.zos.v2r1.apsu000/ppfaovly.htm, https://www.ibm.com/support/knowledgecenter/SSLTBW_2.1.0/com.ibm.zos.v2r1.apsu000/hduovr.htm)
- PPFA is a compiler mapping "line-at-a-time output onto full electronic pages, adding electronic forms, images, and copies" (https://public.dhe.ibm.com/printers/products/as400/iSeries/6250ppfa_draft.pdf)
- Units: inches/mm/cm/points/pels → L-units (default 240/inch); SETUNITS accepts LPI and CPI as default units for POSITION/OFFSET/LINEONE (https://www.ibm.com/docs/SSLTBW_2.2.0/com.ibm.zos.v2r2.ib6p000/ib6p9c9b.htm)
- Line data: ANSI carriage control in column 1 — blank=single space, "0"=double, "-"=triple, "+"=overprint, "1"=skip to channel 1 (top of form), 2–9/A–C=skip to FCB channel; machine codes are hex equivalents (https://docs.precisely.com/docs/sftw/e1-enrichment/7.4.3/en-us/webhelp/DevelopersGuideDITA/PrintStreams/carriage_controls.html); RECFM=FBA (ANSI) vs FBM (machine) (https://docs.bmc.com/docs/arc/42/recfm-925827725.html)

evidence.heading: Fact sheet: how print/output systems model business-form templates/B. Print-stream / page-description forms/PCL / PostScript resident forms

facts.body:
- PCL macro = stored command group (letterhead example); invoked by call, execute, or overlay; "A macro overlay is the final operation each time a page is printed"; Esc&f#X controls define/permanent/auto-overlay; macros are temporary until made permanent (https://developers.hp.com/system/files/attachments/PCL%20Implementors%20Guide-18-macros.pdf)
- Printer-resident forms: define Esc&f10y0X … Esc&f1X, make permanent Esc&f10y10X, enable auto overlay Esc&f10y4X (runs on every page until Esc&f5X); printers ship a "Table of Installed Fonts/Macros" (https://pic.hallikainen.org/techref/language/pcl/efpint.htm)
- PostScript Level 2 form = dictionary {FormType 1, BBox, Matrix, PaintProc}; executed with execform; output "depends only on the graphics state"; CTM positions it; form cache (https://pic.hallikainen.org/techref/language/PS/execform.htm)

evidence.heading: Fact sheet: how print/output systems model business-form templates/B. Print-stream / page-description forms/PDF/VT and PPML

facts.body:
- PDF/VT (ISO 16612-2) requires a DPart hierarchy (inner nodes = parts, leaves = recipient pages) with Document Part Metadata (DPM) key-values and a DPartRoot "record level" key, for record selection/postage; reuse via XObjects; PDF/VT-1 (PDF/X-4), -2 (external references), -2s (MIME streaming) (https://pdfa.org/wp-content/until2016_uploads/2011/08/Technical-Introduction-to-PDF-VT.pdf, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PDF/VT); ISO 16612-1 covered PPML/VDX (same Wikipedia URL)
- PPML (PODi, 2000): XML describing how resources combine into "pages, documents and jobs"; reusable resources defined once, rasterized once, referenced by URL with checksums; PPML/GA requires PS/PDF/TIFF/JPEG resources (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PPML)

evidence.heading: Fact sheet: how print/output systems model business-form templates/B. Print-stream / page-description forms/Xerox LCDS / Metacode / VIPP

facts.body:
- LCDS "originated as EBCDIC impact printer data" with embedded controls; files "do not contain any information about the position, formatting" and rely on JSL and DJDE; forms stored on the printer avoid resending them (https://www.compart.com/en/lcds)
- DJDE is a Xerox standard for inserting print control statements (new page, change fonts) into line data (https://cdpcom.com/products/developer-apis/xerox-djde-api/); FRM form resources are wrapped with DJDEs so the printer stores them on local disk (https://docs.oracle.com/cd/E51711_01/UI/help/Utils/WX/XERDNLD.html)
- VIPP is PostScript-dictionary macros; modes: Database (delimited file, e.g. billing), Line ("adds form overlays, font selection, color… to an existing print application"), XML, Native; form invoked by "(formname) SETFORM" where the form resides on the controller (DocuSP/FreeFlow) (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Variable_Data_Intelligent_Postscript_Printware)

evidence.heading: Fact sheet: how print/output systems model business-form templates/C. Dot-impact / continuous forms/ESC/P and IBM Proprinter

facts.body:
- ESC C n = page length in lines; ESC C NUL n = page length in inches; ESC N n = skip-over-perforation (bottom margin), ESC O cancels; ESC 2 = 1/6" (6 LPI), ESC 0 = 1/8" (8 LPI); ESC l n left margin, ESC Q n right margin; ESC P 10 cpi, ESC M 12 cpi, ESC g 15 cpi; SI condensed, DC2 cancel (https://support2.epson.net/manuals/english/page/epl_5800/REF_G/APCOM_3.HTM); ranges n=1–127 lines, 1–22 inches (https://panthema.net/2006/helppc21/HelpPC-2.10-HTML/hw-Epson_printer_codes.html)
- Proprinter: SI = condensed 17.1 cpi, DC2 = back to 10 cpi; ESC C n lines / ESC C 0 m inches; "ESC C sets top of form at the current form position"; top line is line 1 (https://www.ibm.com/support/pages/node/635833); ESC : = 12 cpi; line form 1–255, inch form 1–14 in a Proprinter emulation (https://mcgrp.ru/files/viewer/124151/332)
- Canon ESC/P emulation: default spacing 6 lpi; page-length setting steps of 1/6" (≈4.2 mm); default right margin 345.4 mm (13.6") unless changed by ESC/P settings or commands (https://oip.manual.canon/USRMA-4296-zz-SSS-320-jaJP/contents/devu-apdx-other-prtmode-pgform_escp.html); page length settable by ESC C; a page length beyond printable lines breaks at the printable count (https://oip.manual.canon/USRMA-1621-zz-SS-jaJP/contents/SS312_appendix_0216.html)
- Wide carriage: Epson LQ-2190 is 136 columns, "1 original + 5 copies" (https://www.epson.co.nz/products/dotmatrix/lq2190.asp); "Multi copy forms" typical use (https://www.printerland.co.uk/pdf/epson/LQ2190.pdf)
- Japanese multipart example: Hisago dot-printer 納品書 stock, 3-ply "納品書(控)/納品書/物品受領書" (https://nttxstore.jp/_II_HG10233145); accounting-software FAQ: choose a paper type marked "連続紙" or the second sheet misaligns (https://pca.jp/area_support/kessan_faq/pdf/kon_412.pdf)

- Canon ESC/P emulation: default spacing 6 lpi; page-length setting steps of 1/6" (≈4.2 mm); default right margin 345.4 mm (13.6") unless changed by ESC/P settings or commands (https://oip.manual.canon/USRMA-4296-zz-SSS-320-jaJP/contents/devu-apdx-other-prtmode-pgform_escp.html); page length settable by ESC C; a page length beyond printable lines breaks at the printable count (https://oip.manual.canon/USRMA-1621-zz-SS-jaJP/contents/SS312_appendix_0216.html)
- Wide carriage: Epson LQ-2190 is 136 columns, "1 original + 5 copies" (https://www.epson.co.nz/products/dotmatrix/lq2190.asp); "Multi copy forms" typical use (https://www.printerland.co.uk/pdf/epson/LQ2190.pdf)
- Japanese multipart example: Hisago dot-printer 納品書 stock, 3-ply "納品書(控)/納品書/物品受領書" (https://nttxstore.jp/_II_HG10233145); accounting-software FAQ: choose a paper type marked "連続紙" or the second sheet misaligns (https://pca.jp/area_support/kessan_faq/pdf/kon_412.pdf)

evidence.heading: Fact sheet: how print/output systems model business-form templates/Common patterns (facts observed above)

facts.body:
- Static form stored/resident separately from variable data: AFP overlay+FORMDEF, Xerox FRM/SETFORM, PCL macro overlay, PS execform, ZPL ^DF, SATO ESC&, Brother transferred template.
- Numbered/named fill slots: ZPL ^FN, Brother numbered objects, Dymo object Name, AcroForm T, MERGEFIELD, SBPL/TPCL field definitions with data commands (PC/RC).
- Line-data positioning by grid: LPI/CPI (ESC/P ESC 2/0, ESC P/M/g; PPFA SETUNITS LPI/CPI); page length in lines or inches (ESC C, Proprinter, PAGE LIMIT, pr -l); column-1 carriage control (ANSI/machine) splits pages.
- Label geometry in dots at known dpi: ZPL ^LL/^PW (203.2/304.8…), SBPL ESC A1 dots, TPCL 1/10 mm.
- Overflow handled in the composer, not the stream: XFA flowed subforms with break/leader/trailer; Exstream page-level flow; InDesign records spill to next page; AFP/PCL/ZPL have no overflow concept.
- Channel/format fan-out from one template: SmartCOMM selector (template+channel), Inspire outputs AFP/PS/PCL/Metacode/PDF, Papyrus AFP/PDF, PDF/VT DPM for record metadata.
- Versioning/approval is a repository function: Inspire Content Manager/Approval, Exstream approval workflows + Visual Compare, SmartCOMM branch/withdraw, Papyrus WebRepository sign-off.

facts.body: - NEXT merges the next record into the current document; auto-inserted for label sheets; must follow first MERGEFIELD set; not with SKIPIF (https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/field-codes-next-field-3862fad6-0297-411a-a4e7-6ff5bcf178fd); SKIPIF cancels current merge document and moves to next record (https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/word/field-codes-skipif-field); NEXTIF conditional NEXT (https://bettersolutions.com/word/fields/next-field.htm)
